relations.evidence: In 1926, Dandaron began attending secular school in Kizhinga, where he was taught by the writer Khotsa Namsaraev.

relations.subject: Bidia Dandarovich Dandaron
relations.evidence: In 1933, Dandaron moved to Leningrad (present-day, Saint Petersburg), and studied aeronautical engineering at Leningrad Civil Aviation Institute.

relations.subject: Alexander Piatigorsky
relations.evidence: From the mid-1960s to the early 1970s, young people began travelling to Buryatia to receive Dandaron's Buddhist teachings. Dandaron's students were informally called "Dandaron’s Sangha", and included Alexander Piatigorsky
